subject: Log evacuation & export delivery readiness for EU tenant
messages:
From: Katie Johnson <katie.j@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: export & sterilization plan for EU audit logs

Marcus —

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. As we prepare for an external compliance audit (regulated healthcare, EU residency), my security team needs a concrete plan for: export formats, delivery timeline, proof-of-delivery, and guaranteed removal from Redwood-managed stores once the handoff is complete. Specifically: 

- Can you stream audit/access logs in near-real-time to our EU S3 bucket (customer-owned KMS)?
- For bulk historical extracts, what is the standard turnaround SLA and output formats (JSONL/Parquet/CSV)?
- Do you support a deletion certificate (signed) and manifest (hashes) we can keep as evidence?
- How do legal holds interact with your automatic TTL/retention windows?

I've attached a short spec (log_export_spec_v1.pdf) with our preferred fields. We're trying to map this to the Redwood offering so we can include it in our SOC report.

Appreciate a short plan and next steps by EOD Friday.

—Katie
Security & Privacy, BlueWave Health

Attachment: log_export_spec_v1.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Johnson <katie.j@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: export & sterilization plan for EU audit logs

Katie —

Thanks for the doc and the clear asks. High level answers first, then action items: 

1) Real-time streaming: Yes — for EU tenants we support continuous forwarder to a customer-owned S3 or S3-compatible endpoint. Customer-managed KMS is supported (we will encrypt in transit with TLS and at-rest using your key).

2) Bulk exports: Standard turnaround for a historical bulk snapshot (full tenant audit/access logs) is 72 hours for a one-off export up to 3TB. Output formats: JSONL (default), Apache Parquet (columnar), and CSV (for smaller slices).

3) Proof of deletion / manifests: We can produce a signed export manifest (SHA256 checksums per file) and, upon customer request, an export-deletion receipt. The receipt includes a signed deletion timestamp and list of removed object IDs. For hosted tenants, deletion from Redwood hot and cold stores is automated; we can include an attestable manifest and a GPG-signed certificate.

4) Legal hold: Legal hold pauses scheduled irreversible deletions at the tenant level. Holds must be requested via our support portal (we'll need a signed request & internal approver). While on hold, automatic TTL won't remove data; exports still proceed.

Action items I propose: 
- Neha: can you confirm EU S3 bucket onboarding checklist and provide the presigned ingestion role?
- Grace: prepare the export manifest template (sample attached) and note our signing key TTL.
- I'll schedule a 30-minute runbook review with Katie and her auditors on Friday 10:30 AM CET.

If that timeline looks tight, we can do an initial streaming proof of concept (30 min) earlier.

—Marcus
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Johnson <katie.j@bluewavehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: export & sterilization plan for EU audit logs

Hi Katie —

Quick technical notes from onboarding: 

- EU streaming: we require an IAM role ARN (for AWS) with PutObject + PutObjectAcl to your EU bucket (eu-west-1). For S3-compatible endpoints we'll use an access key pair with export-only scope.
- KMS: Provide the customer-managed KMS key ARN and grant us Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. We will not retain your key.
- Formats: JSONL will include a per-event metadata header (tenant_id, region, kafka_offset, event_ts). Parquet exports are optimized for large historical scans and reduce size by ~6x compared to JSONL for our schema.
- Turnaround SLA: 72 hours for full snapshots; for incremental historic slices (<100GB) we can ship within 8–12 hours.

Attachment: manifest_sample.jsonl (small example with SHA256 and object path).

I'll validate the bucket role and share the onboarding checklist link; Marcus, please confirm you'd like us to run the POC ingestion to Katie's bucket before the Friday call.

—Neha
Senior Platform Ops Engineer
From: Katie Johnson <katie.j@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, audit+bluewave@legalblue.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: export & sterilization plan for EU audit logs

Thanks — that all looks good. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- For the signed deletion receipt: does Redwood provide a machine-verifiable signature (x509 or GPG) and include a list of object ARNs removed? Our auditors want a non-repudiable artifact.
- Can you confirm whether cold archival backups (if any) are also purged as part of the deletion process or if additional steps are required?
- During legal hold, is there a reporting endpoint we can query to confirm which items are held vs eligible for deletion?

We'll send the IAM role + KMS ARN by EOD. The Friday 10:30 CET time works; please share a calendar invite.

—Katie
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Johnson <katie.j@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: export & sterilization plan for EU audit logs

Katie —

Short answers to the follow-ups and confirming the FRIDAY call invite sent (10:30 CET). Calendar link in the hubspot deal.

- Signed deletion receipts: Yes — we issue an x509-signed deletion receipt. It contains: tenant_id, deletion_request_id, list of object paths (object://<bucket>/<path>), deletion timestamp (ISO8601), and SHA256 of the exported archive. The receipt is stored in our audit system and we provide you a downloadable copy.

- Cold archives: For hosted customers we keep immutable snapshots in cold storage for up to the tenant's configured retention window. Deletion requests cascade to cold archives as part of the same workflow; when deletion is requested we queue cold-archive purge jobs (these have a longer completion time and are subject to a 14-day purge window because of provider batch cycles). We include cold-archive purge timestamps in the deletion receipt.

- Legal hold reporting: We expose a read-only API endpoint (GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/holds) that returns active holds (hold_id, scope, applied_by, created_at). We can provide a temporary API key for your audit team on the POC.

I'll attach the deletion-receipt example after the call and share the GPG public key fingerprint.

Next steps we committed on the call:
- POC streaming to your eu-west-1 bucket (Neha) — 24h setup after you send role/KMS.
- Historical export (90 days slice) for auditors — Marcus to kick off after POC.
- Signed deletion receipt template & public key (Grace) — attached after call.

—Grace
Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

Attachments after call: deletion_receipt_example.json, redwood-gpg-fingerprint.txt
